artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan (3 waves, 2h) correcting the latex extension's existing rule file in place -- widened paths glob, new authoritative Continuous Build Safety section, two repaired unconditional blocks -- plus three non-duplicating pointers and an AC1-AC7 acceptance sweep.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system source store, 'verify the change by redeploying' is frequently NOT an executable verification step for an implementer, for two independent reasons that must both be checked before a plan prescribes it. (1) context/patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md licenses exactly ONE automated caller of scripts/deploy-headless.sh -- skill-orchestrate's Stage MT-3 step 7 -- and states the carve-out is explicitly 'not precedent'; any other automated invocation is out of policy. (2) deploy-headless.sh's default mode only resyncs extensions already ACTIVE in the target repo's .claude-extensions.json, so for an inactive extension it silently deploys nothing. The substitute that IS available is source-store static verification plus mechanical replication of the deployer's own parse logic: measure-eager-context.sh deliberately predicts from the source store alone (never reads the deployed tree) and its normalize_paths_field / rule_matches_rep_paths functions are pure enough to replicate in a one-line assertion, e.g. reading a rule's raw paths: value with sed and piping the bracketed form through `jq -r '.[]'`.
